guides.title: The RAG Survey: A Map of Retrieval-Augmented Generation

assets.alt: Example RAG question-answering workflow: a question retrieves passages from a document collection; the passages and question are combined in a prompt for an LLM to answer.
assets.rights: Gao et al., arXiv:2312.10997v5, Figure 2. The arXiv default non-exclusive distribution license grants no right of republication; used only for personal scholarly reading in this private repository.

assets.alt: Technology tree of RAG research: a timeline for 2020, 2023, and 2024, with three branches for pretraining, fine-tuning, and inference-time augmentation, annotated with representative methods.
assets.rights: Gao et al., arXiv:2312.10997v5, Figure 1. The arXiv default non-exclusive distribution license grants no right of republication; used only for personal scholarly reading in this private repository.

assets.alt: Three RAG paradigms: Naive RAG as a linear pipeline; Advanced RAG with pre- and post-retrieval optimization; Modular RAG as flexible composition of modules.
assets.rights: Gao et al., arXiv:2312.10997v5, Figure 3. The arXiv default non-exclusive distribution license grants no right of republication; used only for personal scholarly reading in this private repository.

assets.alt: A quadrant plot comparing prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and RAG by the need to change the model and the need for external knowledge; RAG moves from Naive to Modular and can combine with fine-tuning.
assets.rights: Gao et al., arXiv:2312.10997v5, Figure 4. The arXiv default non-exclusive distribution license grants no right of republication; used only for personal scholarly reading in this private repository.

assets.alt: Three retrieval-augmentation processes: iterative retrieval alternates retrieval and generation; recursive retrieval rewrites or decomposes the query; adaptive retrieval lets the model decide whether and when to retrieve.
assets.rights: Gao et al., arXiv:2312.10997v5, Figure 5. The arXiv default non-exclusive distribution license grants no right of republication; used only for personal scholarly reading in this private repository.
